title: Keyboard Enter is mapped for the panel but never emitted by the poll
evidence: if rl.IsKeyPressed(.UP) { ... } if rl.IsKeyPressed(.DOWN) { ... } if rl.IsKeyPressed(.LEFT) { ... } if rl.IsKeyPressed(.RIGHT) { ... } --- and in mouse.odin: case .Up, .Down, .Left, .Right, .Enter: if keys_n < len(keys) { keys[keys_n] = e.key; keys_n += 1 } ... case .Enter: append(out, Intent(Settings_Activate{delta = 0}))
detail: poll_mouse emits Up/Down/Left/Right but no Enter; the panel-open Enter case in mouse_map is unreachable, so delta-0 keyboard activation silently does nothing.
recommended_fix: Add `if rl.IsKeyPressed(.ENTER) { append(&inp.events, Device_Event(Key_Press{key = .Enter})) }` to poll_mouse (and confirm Key.Enter exists).

title: An in-progress drag is left dangling when the panel opens
detail: Opening the panel mid-drag suppresses all release/move handling; drag.active and placement state persist indefinitely with no cancel or commit, resuming stale on close.
recommended_fix: When Toggle_Settings opens the panel, cancel any active drag/placement (or clear drag state) so close never resumes a stale gesture.

title: View comment references a nonexistent `hud_s` field
evidence:
`hud_s` is the scaled
	// int helper's factor — keep reads through hud()/hud_f()
detail: The added comment names `hud_s`, a field that appears nowhere in the diff; misleading documentation on the new scale knob.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the comment to reference ui_scale directly.

title: palette_mode_name and PALETTE_MODE_COUNT are defined but never used in the diff
detail: Neither symbol is referenced anywhere else in the diff; either intended for consumers absent from this chunk or genuinely dead.
recommended_fix: Remove them or confirm their consumers exist outside this chunk.

title: panel_row comment cites SETTINGS_ROWS, constant is SETTINGS_ROW_COUNT
evidence: panel_row:  i32, // the focused settings row (0..SETTINGS_ROWS-1)
detail: The documented bound references SETTINGS_ROWS; the shipped constant (render/settings_panel.odin) is SETTINGS_ROW_COUNT — a reader greps for a symbol that does not exist.

title: qos geometry test uses an unscaled '+20' text-width allowance
evidence: testing.expect(t, val + 20 <= ppp.x, "the value fits before the plus button")
detail: The asserted text width is a raw constant while the drawn glyph width scales with the knob; at x1.50 the real text can overflow the asserted gap the test claims to pin.
recommended_fix: Scale the allowance (e.g. hud_f(&v, 20)) or derive it from the actual font metrics.

title: keys buffer sized to exactly the reachable key set with zero headroom
evidence: keys: [10]Key ... if keys_n < len(keys) { keys[keys_n] = .S; keys_n += 1 }
detail: Ten collection sites fill ten slots exactly; any future key (or Enter once emitted) silently drops presses behind the bounds guard with no diagnostic.
recommended_fix: Size the buffer above the worst case or assert/log when a key is dropped.

title: Touch panel-open branch unconditionally clears press_swallowed before the UI hook
detail: exec sets press_swallowed=true when the panel opens; a subsequent touch press in the modal branch resets it to false before the hook runs, weakening the release-swallow guarantee the latch exists for.
recommended_fix: Set the latch only after the hook returns (true→swallowed, false→leave prior latch intact) rather than pre-clearing.
